items.title: Loretta Rowland Evans Interview
items.q: Commissioner Shero congratulated them on the skit they put on.

ctx.x: Mostly religious music that they were teaching. But you did get training on your instrument.

Oh and early up to the fifth grade I went to public school and we was taught other music and other songs you see. When I went to public school we used to go to make down a statue and make fun of day and bring flowers. Up to the fifth grade I went to public and then I left and from then on I went through a parocial. Then I went to Redemptus and finished there. Did you sing when you brought those flowers to the statue? We sang. I used to sing in the choir. I used to like to sing. Next time they have something at…
What did you sing when you went up to McDonald's statue?
